subject_definitions:

summary:

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] storyboard reference): partially_preserved - the viewpoint, subject placement and framing are followed, while the shot develops in time away from that exact arrangement.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers. The camera holds a static shot. His already-raised gaze narrows a fraction and holds on the far point off frame; a single bead of sweat slides down his temple, and the muscle along his jaw draws tight once and stays tight. wind only, the ambient drops away. [Shot 2] At 00:02.375, the camera cuts to the framing holds a medium two-shot. The camera stands on the red-dirt road outside the prison gate at eye level, about 1.5 metres up, facing the rusted iron gate straight on. The camera holds a static shot. The bearded man strides in from the left edge and closes the gap in two long steps, his raised right hand travelling forward until the palm lands flat on the younger man's left shoulder and pushes it down a centimetre; the younger man's shoulder gives under the impact while his own arms stay at his sides. The speaker (S1) says, loud and rough with relief pressed flat under it, <d>[Chinese] 江老弟，你可算出来了！</d> quick footfalls on dirt, a dull slap of palm on cloth.

overall_soundscape:
Wind only, the ambient drops away. Quick footfalls on dirt, a dull slap of palm on cloth.
